entries.label: calculator
entries.whyLarge: Calculator UI, module drawing surfaces, estimate state, and presentation helpers are still concentrated in a few client files, though standalone/project route ownership now lives in calculatorWorkspace and pure calculator input defaults, normalization, browser-draft persistence/session state, module navigation modelling and presentation, configuration-section definitions and presentation, issue labels/section ownership/model construction, pricing-summary presentation, preview-split sizing and persistence, price-impact ranking/presentation and styles, save-readiness, quote-status/save-preflight helpers, the guided infill dialog, selected-infill header, Opening/Supports/Results stage presenters, visual infill shape-template picker/model, support-confirmation model, infill UI/payload plus summary view-model helpers, infill overview/list presenters, save dialog presenters, flashings view-model helpers, and blinds view-model helpers now live outside CalculatorGridClient.
entries.nextSafeExtraction: Move infill draft/state orchestration into a dedicated controller before adding unrelated calculator workflows.

entries.label: design workbench
entries.ownerArea: Drawing workbench UI and drawing domain adapters
entries.whyLarge: Viewports, render graph wiring, interaction state, compatibility fallbacks, and browser gestures are still being separated.
entries.nextSafeExtraction: Move pure interaction math, render preparation, and compatibility adapters out of viewport presenters before adding new tools or overlays.
focusedTests: browser fixture smoke when UI changes

entries.label: geometry package
entries.whyLarge: Solvers, house model contracts, projections, and fixtures are central package truth with broad consumers.
entries.nextSafeExtraction: Split solver phases, normalized model contracts, and projection helpers by physical responsibility while preserving public package exports.

entries.label: schedule
entries.whyLarge: Board, Gantt, Site Visits, readiness, and legacy fallback remain heavy interactive surfaces.
entries.nextSafeExtraction: Extract workflow-specific clients, query/view models, and command adapters before adding new schedule modes.

entries.label: project quote tab
entries.whyLarge: Local-first state, quote lifecycle, PDF/email side effects, and UI state sit close together.
entries.nextSafeExtraction: Move lifecycle policy, side-effect orchestration, and tab view models into named helpers before adding more inline tab behavior.

entries.label: marketing enquiry route
entries.ownerArea: Public enquiry intake and conversion workflow
entries.whyLarge: Request validation, indicative estimate preparation, project/contact/enquiry persistence, attachment staging, autoresponder delivery, outbox recording, attribution, and audit fallback still meet in one public route.
entries.nextSafeExtraction: Move enquiry persistence and autoresponder/outbox audit orchestration behind named domain owners before JOB-07 migrates accepted delivery work; keep authentication-independent request validation and truthful response shaping in the route.

entries.label: marketing start
entries.whyLarge: Page-level presentation, product selection, conversion copy, and interaction paths are concentrated in one public page.
entries.nextSafeExtraction: Extract section components, content data, and conversion state helpers before adding new campaign branches.
